name: mvp-demo
description: Hackathon starter: React + Hono + Postgres monorepo with auth, CRUD, realtime, LLM and an optional Python service.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,py -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev:py"
scripts.lint: biome check api web shared scripts package.json biome.json tsconfig.base.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:web && npm run build
scripts.lint:py: uv run --directory py ruff check . && uv run --directory py ruff format --check .
scripts.check:py: npm run lint:py && npm run test:py
scripts.dev:js: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
